events.verdict: McBride (NYK) engages with Sharpe (BKN) as he moves around the screen and does not affect his FOM.
Towns (NYK) maintains a legal guarding position alongside of Sharpe (POR) during his drive to the basket and shot attempt.
Avdija (POR) legally contests Anunoby's (NYK) jump shot, making "high-five" contact after the ball is released.

Replay review of the out of bounds called on Avdija (POR) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed successful. The ball is last touched by Hart (NYK) before going out of bounds and play resumes with Portland possession.
McBride (NYK) grazes the back of Henderson's (POR) head during his shot attempt and the contact is marginal.

After communicating with the Replay Center, it is determined that the shot attempt does not make contact with the rim and therefore the shot clock is not reset. Play resumes with the game clock set to 00:19.0 and the shot clock set to 2.5 seconds remaining.
Avdija (POR) legally contests Bridges' (NYK) jump shot attempt.
Hart (NYK) makes clean contact with the ball to briefly dislodge it from Clingan's (POR) possession.
McBride (NYK) extends his leg out and kicks the ball.
Hart (NYK) maintains a legal guarding position moving alongside of Henderson's (POR) path during his drive to the basket.
Robinson (NYK) moves forwards into Henderson (POR), initiating illegal contact that affects his shot attempt near the rim.
Towns (NYK) cleanly blocks Avdija's (POR) driving shot attempt.
Clingan (POR) fails to release his shot attempt prior to the expiration of the shot clock.
Towns (NYK) and Clingan (POR) briefly engage and disengage as Clingan moves to set the pick.
Anunoby (NYK) is the last player to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds.
Bridges (NYK) legally contests Simons' (POR) jump shot attempt.
Towns (NYK) has his foot extended and kicks the ball.
McBride (NYK) extends an arm into Henderson (POR), affecting his SQBR.
Anunoby (NYK) maintains verticality and absorbs the contact that occurs during Henderson's (POR) layup attempt. Any contact by McBride (NYK) during the drive to the basket is marginal.
Henderson (POR) is the last player to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds.
Bridges (NYK) begins to lose his balance on his own accord, but remains in front of Avidja (POR) during his drive to the basket and absorbs the contact.
Hart (NYK) takes multiple steps along the baseline and leaves the designated throw-in spot.
Robinson (NYK) cleanly blocks Avdija's (POR) shot attempt.
Hart (NYK) makes illegal contact to Avdija's (POR) arm during his shot attempt.
Towns (NYK) firms up in a screening position in Henderson's (POR) path and Henderson loses his balance attempting to move around Towns.
Bridges (NYK) gathers the ball and legally takes two steps into his jump shooting motion.
Clingan (POR) legally contests Bridges' (NYK) jump shot attempt.
